- 2,000 randomized format → parse → reformat round-trips.

### Interpretation choices
- Alignment padding applies to header cells as well as body cells, since the spec describes padding for all cells.
- A pipe is treated as escaped when immediately preceded by `\`; this pairs with the simple “escape every `|`” rule and round-trips reliably.
- Trailing blank/whitespace-only lines are stripped; only that tolerance is applied beyond the stated parsing rules.
